staleAllowCoverage.scenario: An in-flight Allow evaluated against a release revoked by rollback cannot be recorded.
An old returned Allow cannot replace fresh authorization before effect storage.

redRun.detail: The new coverage test could not load a frozen revocation SLA or complete the path inventory before the profile and lifecycle assertions were added.

combinedRegressionRun.command: node --test <20 frozen C06, product PEP, and C15 integration test files>

verifiedAssertions: The frozen profile and a source scan contain the same ten currently implemented product PEP modules.
Each implemented product PEP invokes C06 again and denies the first action started after the Synthetic revocation commit.
All six representative surfaces deny their first post-revocation action.
A warm C07 cache is authorized before cache-adapter access and cannot serve after revocation.
C06 decision storage rejects a stale in-flight Allow after the active release or activation version changes.
C15 cannot use a previously returned Allow to bypass fresh authorization before effect storage.
limitations: The zero-millisecond observations are deterministic in-process Synthetic measurements, not evidence of production network, distributed-cache or multi-region propagation.
DOWNLOAD and O01 SANDBOX_RUN do not yet have product implementations; only their representative C06 PEP surfaces are covered and this supplement does not claim those future paths are complete.
The source inventory detects current direct Authorization Facade and PEP SDK consumers; future indirect consumers must be added to the profile and acceptance test when implemented.
This supplement does not change any recorded P1 status, reopen or approve G1, enter P2, or authorize P3 enterprise integration.
